rows.subtype: Tradition: honours customs and family ways [Actor]
rows.description: A young adult keeps festivals, fasts and family rituals with devotion, finding belonging and meaning in them; respecting inherited ways can sit peacefully or in tension with new ideas.

rows.subtopic: Schwartz values: stimulation, achievement, power, security, conformity, tradition
rows.description: A young professional chooses a steady job and saves carefully, valuing certainty and safety for family over chances; calm and worry can both come with the choice.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.subtopic: Schwartz values: stimulation, achievement, power, security, conformity, tradition
rows.subtype: Seeing that values compete and choosing a ranking [Response]
rows.description: An adult sees that freedom, security and tradition cannot all rank first each time, names which one matters most in this choice, and respects others whose rankings differ.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A child says "I will share my pencil if you share your eraser", judging right by what gives a fair exchange for oneself; other people's needs matter mainly as part of the trade.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 23–26

rows.subtype: Feels cheated when kindness is not returned [Receiver]
rows.description: A child who lent a toy and got nothing back declares "never again"; they read helping as an exchange and feel wronged when the balance breaks.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 23–26

rows.subtype: Helping a child see beyond the deal [Response]
rows.description: A parent or teacher asks "how would he feel if nobody shared with him?", drawing attention from trade to feelings and shared life, without shaming the child's fair-play instinct.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: A teenager offers to do chores if they can have a phone, treating duty as a price; the deal-making is practical and honest, but it is not yet care for the family.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 23–26

rows.description: An adult helps a colleague only if it may pay off later and keeps a mental ledger of favours; the mindset can produce fair dealing but leaves relationships thin.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17
